caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table with an octagonal top, colored in shades of brown. The tabletop is darker in the center, bordered by a lighter brown edge. The front of the table has two locks with brass or gold-colored keyhole escutcheons. Below the locks, the apron of the table is scalloped and contains decorative cutouts. The table stands on four turned and carved legs, also in a brown wood tone, which are connected by curved stretchers shaped in an elegant X-form pattern for additional support. The entire composition is centered on a plain off-white or cream background bordered by thin lines, and there is a small artist's signature in the lower right corner.
title: Tea Table
